CB.name: Ball-playing centre back
CB.text: On the ball a lot for a centre back, passing and carrying it forward.

CB.name: No-nonsense centre back
CB.text: Clears and wins headers in their own third; on the ball less than most centre backs.

CB.name: Front-foot centre back
CB.text: Steps up to win the ball: tackles and interceptions high up, fewer clearances.

FB.name: Attacking fullback
FB.text: Plays high: crosses, gets into the box, takes players on and shoots.

FB.name: Defensive fullback
FB.text: Stays deep: clears and wins headers in their own third, rarely gets forward to cross.

FB.name: Inverted fullback
FB.text: Comes inside to build play: on the ball a lot, progressive passes, rarely wide or crossing.

CM_DM.name: Holding midfielder
CM_DM.text: Sits in front of the defence: interceptions and clearances in their own third, rarely in the box.

CM_DM.name: Deep-lying playmaker
CM_DM.text: Runs the game from deep: on the ball a lot, long and progressive passes.

CM_DM.name: Ball-winning midfielder
CM_DM.text: Wins the ball: tackles, interceptions and loose balls, higher up the pitch than most.

CM_DM.name: Box-to-box midfielder
CM_DM.text: Gets forward: plays high, into the box, shoots, carries the ball forward and picks up loose balls.

AM.name: Playmaker
AM.text: Creates between the lines: on the ball a lot, through balls and progressive passes, less often in the box.

AM.name: Shadow striker
AM.text: Plays off the striker: gets into the box and shoots, on the ball less than most.

AM.name: Carrier
AM.text: Runs with the ball: carries it, takes players on, gains ground with it.

W.name: Inside forward
W.text: Cuts inside: shoots and gets into the box, less often wide or crossing.

W.name: Touchline winger
W.text: Stays wide and crosses; shoots less than most wingers.

W.name: Dribbler
W.text: Beats players: take-ons, carries, ground gained with the ball.

W.name: Wide playmaker
W.text: Creates from wide: on the ball a lot, progressive passes and through balls, less often in the box.

ST.name: Target forward
ST.text: Wins headers in and around the box; carries and dribbles less than most strikers.

ST.name: Penalty-box striker
ST.text: Lives in the box: shoots from close in, on the ball less than most strikers.

ST.name: False 9 / link-up
ST.text: Drops off to link play: on the ball a lot, passes and carries forward, less often in the box.

ST.name: Pressing forward
ST.text: Wins the ball back from the front: tackles and loose balls high up the pitch.
